    Exactness of almost split sequences on radical layers #

    Proposition 2.6(1)(2) (prop:graded-realization), in filtered form, at the canonical right mesh of a vertex x of Γ_A: the minimal right almost split map E_x → x (with E_x decomposed into chosen indecomposables, and rad P → P at a projective vertex) and its kernel τx (zero at a projective vertex). For a family w_i : W → E_i of maps into the summands:

    • (lowest degree) ∑ w_i β_i ∈ J² implies every w_i ∈ J;
    • (exactness at the middle) if every w_i ∈ J^{n+1} and ∑ w_i β_i ∈ J^{n+3}, then w_i ≡ z α_i modulo J^{n+2} for one z ∈ J^n(W, τx);
    • (injectivity) if every z α_i ∈ J^{n+2}, then z ∈ J^{n+1}.

    Here α_i : τx → E_i and β_i : E_i → x are the components of the two maps. At a projective vertex the left term is zero, which gives Proposition 2.6(2). The statements are proved in mod A, from Lemma 2.5, and hold for every finitely generated W.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
